title: HETUS 2000/2010: participation rate in the main activity by sex and time of the day (tus_00startime)
used_for: The diurnal participation profile. This is the single most important HETUS table for a semi-Markov engine, because it constrains WHEN each activity happens rather than only how long it lasts. TUNING-EXPOSED for activity timing: U32's sleep offsets and week 3's appliance timing are derived from it, so the awake-share fit and the V0 activity-share check are CONSISTENCY checks against a calibration input and NOT independent validations. The independent check on the resulting load shape is LP1 via PL-PEAK-01, exposure 'none'. See I-060.
